segments.text: Hi, my name is Sujata Gibson.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I am a civil rights attorney in Ithaca, New York, the principal attorney at the Gibson law firm, and I teach part-time at Cornell Law School in the area of civil rights and movement law.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I will be presenting on the civil rights panel and also presenting a keynote speech at the conference.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: on the role of movement lawyers in this pandemic litigation.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: This pandemic has been used to grab unprecedented powers and has resulted in widespread erosion of our most basic civil rights, human rights, and constitutional freedoms.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It is vital that all of us movement lawyers, all of us lawyers who care and see what's going on,
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: communicate with one another and get together to really understand what we're doing here to support this movement and to take back our democracy and ensure that our most basic rights are not run roughshod and do not get lost forever.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: There's a lot of cases out there and we need help.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So if you are considering doing this kind of litigation, it is vital that you come and that we get to meet you and you get to meet us.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I think there's some great presenters at this conference and I'm really looking forward to meeting you all.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
